seo.title: Services: Innovation, Spatial Development | McCate
seo.description: Innovation and strategic development, spatial development and interim management. How McCate & Company helps organisations move from plan to result.

title: Services
sub: Three ways to work together. Each one starts with understanding why you do what you do.

items.title: Innovation and strategic development
items.text: Innovation is hard when capacity is limited and stepping outside the comfort zone is uncomfortable. We provide out-of-the-box, strategic solutions that make you more future-proof, quickly.
bullets: Value proposition and business model design

items.title: Spatial development
items.text: Area and location projects slow down when stakeholders, plans and decisions do not line up. We bring structure, shared understanding and pace to the process.

items.title: Interim management
items.text: When a process needs a steady hand, we step in as interim manager. We take responsibility for results, speed up the work and leave you with a team that can continue.

cta: Not sure which fits? Describe your situation and we will tell you what we would do first.
